from pptx import Presentation
from pptx.util import Inches, Pt

# 影片資訊
video_info = {
    "解析度": "1920 x 1080",
    "Codec": "h264 (libx264, High Profile)",
    "檔案大小": "3.89 MB (3,976,812 bytes)",
    "格式": "MP4 (QuickTime/MOV)",
    "幀率": "30 fps",
    "像素格式": "yuv420p",
    "位元率": "6,358,918 bps (~6.36 Mbps)",
    "時長": "5 秒"
}

prs = Presentation()
prs.slide_width = Inches(10)
prs.slide_height = Inches(7.5)

slide_layout = prs.slide_layouts[1]  # Title and Content
slide = prs.slides.add_slide(slide_layout)

title = slide.shapes.title
title.text = "測試影片資訊"

# 添加內容
content = slide.placeholders[1]
tf = content.text_frame
tf.clear()

for key, value in video_info.items():
    p = tf.add_paragraph()
    p.text = f"{key}: {value}"
    p.level = 0
    p.font.size = Pt(18)

prs.save('/tmp/video_spec.pptx')
print("PowerPoint 已儲存: /tmp/video_spec.pptx")
"}
